# Academic positions

```{r}
library(tibble)
tribble(
  ~ Position, ~ Years, ~ Institution,
  "Assistant Professor", "2025-Present", "Mount Royal University",
  "Postdoctoral Fellow", "2022-2025", "University of Manitoba",
) %>%
  detailed_entries(Position, Years, Institution)
```
